note: True free-flight dates for LATAM payloads whose SATCAT LAUNCH_DATE is the ISS's own (1998-11-20, Zarya), inherited via COSPAR designator 1998-067xx. Each date is sourced. Where a payload was ejected from the ISS inside a secondary dispenser, the recorded date is the FREE-FLIGHT date, not the ejection date, and both are noted.

39571.name: UAPSAT 1
39571.detail: Released 07:30 UTC from the Kibo airlock via NanoRacks deployer by JAXA astronaut Koichi Wakata.

40117.name: CHASQUI-1
40117.detail: Hand-released 14:23 UTC during Russian EVA-39 by Expedition 40 crew Skvortsov and Artemyev.

40389.name: AESP-14
40389.detail: J-SSOD #3 from Kibo, ~12:50 UTC. 10th satellite deployed from Kibo.

40897.name: SERPENS
40897.detail: J-SSOD #4 from Kibo, ~12:12 UTC. 12th satellite deployed from Kibo.

41931.name: TANCREDO-1 (UbatubaSat)
41931.detail: TWO-STAGE. Ejected from the ISS inside TuPOD on 2017-01-16 10:50 UTC (J-SSOD #6) but not free-flying; TuPOD dispensed it 2017-01-19 ~23:30 UTC. The free-flight date is recorded. Conflicting pre-slip dates (ARRL 2016-12-19/21) and a typo'd year (Gunter, '20 January 2016') were rejected. First TubeSats ever deployed in space, from the first 3D-printed orbital dispenser.

43468.name: BATSU-CS1 (Irazu)
43468.detail: J-SSOD from Kibo, 10:30/10:40 UTC, alongside 1KUNS-PF (Kenya). No camera aboard.

45598.name: QUETZAL-1
45598.detail: JAXA's release says 'April 29th (Japan time)'; JST is UTC+9, so the UTC date is April 28. Exact clock time not published.

47931.name: GUARANISAT-1
47931.detail: J-SSOD from Kibo, one of eight CubeSats that day, with the other BIRDS-4 satellites.

55129.name: SPORT
55129.detail: Deployed 13:55 UTC alongside petitSat. Space-weather mission, no imaging payload.

67685.name: GXIBA-1
67685.detail: J-SSOD#35 from Kibo; JAXA confirmed success in a 2026-02-09 release. Carried to the ISS on HTV-X1, launched from Tanegashima 2025-10. Targets Popocatepetl and Volcan de Colima.
